ValidationRule.description: Either too many or too few conditions set which would cause the extension to fail.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( ISBLANK( Minimum__c ) && ISBLANK( Maximum__c) && ISBLANK( Contains_Text__c ) ) || ( ( NOT( ISBLANK( Minimum__c ) ) || NOT( ISBLANK( Maximum__c ) ) ) && NOT( ISBLANK( Contains_Text__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Uncertain extension criteria. Only set the numerical values of Minimum and/or Maximum; or set the Match Operator with a Text/Date Value
